{{Quote|For the Republic!|Thorn's last words|<ref name="TCW CatH" />}}
'''Thorn''' was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He carried a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] that he called the "[[Hammer/Legends|Hammer]]."

==Biography==
{{Quote|What is it, Commander Thorn?''"<br />"''We're under attack by the Separatist garrison. Looks to be a full invasion!''"<br />"Invasion?"<br />"''We can't get to you! I suggest you get to a ship as soon as you can!|Padmé Amidala is warned by Thorn, only moments prior to the Separatist invasion of Scipio|<ref name="TCW CatH" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Thorn and a group of his [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|Shock Troopers]] escorted Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to the planet Scipio to negotiate in bringing the Banking Clans to the Republic from the Separatists. However, soon after, Thorn and his men saw a Separatist invasion force heading straight toward them. Thorn alerted Senator Amidala of the attack and readied his men for the fight ahead.

[[File:ThornDeath_CatH.png|thumb|left|250px|Thorn's death]]
With deadly speed and accuracy, [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|droid bombers]] shot down the gunships and the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]], leaving Thorn and his team with no reinforcements. As Thorn and his men rushed toward the entrance of the neutral zone, [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|droid gunships]] then entered the firefight and blocked Thorn's path in the front and the landing pad behind him, cutting down his troopers and deploying [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]]. Another gunship released droids behind them, catching Thorn's squad in a crossfire. Surrounded, but not defeated, the Guard held their ground against the droids in a last effort. After all his men were killed, Thorn yelled out a Republic war cry and kept fighting, using his "Hammer" as a melee and ranged weapon. However, he was greatly outnumbered, and was shot multiple times in the chest until he was finally killed by a commando droid.<ref name="TCW CatH" />

==Equipment==
Thorn sported the Coruscant Guard's standard red colors, but with wing designs on his helmet and a military officer's badge on his chest. He also wore a [[Kama/Legends|kama]] and a black visor. In battle, Thorn utilized a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster as well as two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster pistols]], but he favored his chaingun, a Z-6 rotary blaster cannon which he named "The Hammer," which had it's name written on its side in Aurebesh.

==Behind the scenes==
Thorn was created by [[Dave Filoni]] and the story team of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' as an homage to the character [[Wikipedia:Thor|Thor]] in [[Marvel Comics]]' 2012 movie [[Wikipedia:The Avengers (2012 film)|''The Avengers'']] (which at the time of Thorn's unveilment had just been released), as the episode director [[Steward Lee]] was the biggest Marvel fan among the Clone Wars crew. Filoni first revealed an image of Thorn on his Facebook page on [[May 14]], [[2012]] and stated that the character would appear in ''[[The Clone Wars: Season Five]]'', but the episode arc in which he appeared was moved to the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].
